entry.title: SwiGLU feed-forward blocks for character-level Transformers
entry.summary: SwiGLU feed-forward blocks improve a character-level Transformer language model at equal parameter count by smoothing the loss landscape. We report results on several corpora.

entry.title: Dropout schedules for recurrent networks
entry.summary: Dropout improves recurrent networks trained on small corpora by smoothing the loss landscape. We study dropout schedules.

entry.title: Tiny character-level Transformer language models trained for a fixed step budget
entry.summary: We train a tiny character-level Transformer language model for a fixed step budget and compare several architecture choices on validation loss, including setting activation functions and normalization layers.
